t: You are looking at the Hippodrome, on the corner of Cranbourn Street and Charing Cross Road. It is now a casino with live cabaret, and it used to be a theatre. The word hippodrome is an old term for places that hosted horse races and other equestrian shows, and the name was used for many theatres and music halls. This is one of only a few survivors. Frank Matcham designed it in 1900. He specialised in theatres and music halls, and over a 40-year career he designed more than 90 theatres and redesigned about 80 more.
